segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הֲדַס הַגָּזוּל וְהַיָּבֵשׁ — פָּסוּל. שֶׁל אֲשֵׁרָה וְשֶׁל עִיר הַנִּדַּחַת — פָּסוּל. נִקְטַם רֹאשׁוֹ, נִפְרְצוּ עָלָיו, אוֹ שֶׁהָיוּ עֲנָבָיו מְרוּבּוֹת מֵעָלָיו — פָּסוּל. וְאִם מִיעֲטָן — כָּשֵׁר, וְאֵין מְמַעֲטִין בְּיוֹם טוֹב.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «A myrtle branch that was stolen or that is» completely «dry is unfit. A myrtle branch of a tree worshipped as idolatry [asheira] or» a myrtle branch «from a city» whose residents were «incited» to idolatry «is unfit.» If «the top» of the myrtle branch «was severed,» if «the leaves were severed» completely, or if «its berries were more numerous than its leaves, it is unfit. If one diminished their» number by plucking berries so that they no longer outnumbered the leaves, the myrtle branch is «fit. But one may not diminish» the number «on the Festival» itself.

moves.summary: lists the disqualifications of the myrtle

positions.claim: stolen, dry, asheira, idolatrous-city, severed-top, stripped, or berry-heavy myrtle is unfit; reducing berries makes it fit, but not on the Festival
